name: measure_temperature_and_sort
definition: Measure the current temperature of a substance with a thermometer and place the substance in the appropriate colored box based on a threshold.

name: measure_melting_point_and_classify
definition: Measure or determine the melting point of a substance and focus on the correct colored box based on a threshold.

name: test_electrical_conductivity
definition: Determine whether an object conducts electricity by placing it in a circuit and observing whether current flows, then place it in the corresponding colored box.

name: find_object_by_category_and_move
definition: Locate an object belonging to a specified broad category (animal, plant, living thing, or non-living thing) and move it to a specified colored box.

name: find_animal_by_lifespan
definition: Identify and focus on the animal(s) with the longest and/or shortest lifespan among the animals in the outside location.

name: grow_fruit_crosspollination
definition: Grow one or more plants from seeds by providing required conditions; when a specified fruit is required, grow multiple plants and crosspollinate them to produce it.

name: change_state_of_matter
definition: Heat or cool a substance to change its state of matter (e.g., melt a solid or boil a liquid), or combust it if it has no boiling point.

name: create_substance_chemistry
definition: Use chemical mixing to create a specified substance or paint, focusing on the required intermediate or final product.

name: power_light_bulb
definition: Build a closed electrical circuit to turn on a specified light bulb.

name: order_life_stages
definition: Identify and focus on the life stages of a specified organism in order from earliest to latest.
